name: log-peaking-guard
description: Structured log, probe of the save guard of peaking: event pk_guard. The guard of data/specs/peaking-save-guard.json writes 2 to the latch byte L while it holds the lines back. The probe reads L at each focus-ring event while MF Assist is on (the handler rcvStartMFAssistIn_MFAssistOn of the MF Assist state object) and writes one record per hold: the heap mode, and the units in use in the pool of the heap modes 0 and 2, which is the reason for the hold. A hold with no ring event after its start gives no pk_guard record; pk_latch shows every hold (L = 2). One hook in stock bytes of segment 2 and its routine in segment 2; no byte of the peaking code changes. Needs log-core, log-probes and log-peaking-time before it: every expect is a byte string of that build. It puts the build id da49b2f5e7e62ca7 of data/logdict/events.json into the block header. DEBUG builds only. See experiments/2026-11-14-focus-peaking/NOTES.md section 18 and docs/reference/logging.md.
_ram: 1 byte of the log's state block (PST+100)

ops._note: hook (pk_guard): jmp T_GRD + nop + nop. CmpSts_MfAssist::rcvStartMFAssistIn_MFAssistOn 0x7EB7DE46, entry: `mov a0,a3` / `mov imm32,d0` (a focus-ring event while MF Assist is on; GUI task, segment 2)
flush task, block header: build id bytes 0-3 fe2f543f -> da49b2f5 (data/logdict/events.json)
flush task, block header: build id bytes 4-7 94c74a91 -> e7e62ca7 (data/logdict/events.json)
